title: DNS & DHCP Troubleshooting
subject: Networking Services
description: 30 enterprise tickets (15 DNS, 15 DHCP). Use the 4-step workflow to document your triage, diagnosis, fix steps, and change note. Answers are not provided—your job is to determine the cause and the fix.

tickets.title: Domain join fails for DEPOT-LT17
tickets.summary: A technician reports that joining DEPOT-LT17 to the domain fails. Network connectivity to the domain controller IP appears normal.

env.Impact: Device cannot be onboarded to domain

workflow.triage: Capture the symptom clearly: who is impacted, where, and what error message or behavior is observed. Note scope and urgency.
workflow.diagnosis: State the most likely root cause and the evidence you would collect to confirm it (tools, logs, commands, and configuration checks).
workflow.fix: Document the exact GUI-based remediation steps you would take (and any safe verification steps).
workflow.changeNote: Write a concise change record: what changed, why, risk/impact, and how you validated success.

validations: Confirm name resolution for required domain resources
Verify client uses the intended DNS servers
